desc: Parse \(N\) and the adjacency matrix, storing incoming and outgoing neighbors grouped by character.
Initialize all pair-state distances with diagonal states at 0 and direct-edge states at 1, enqueueing each state once.
Implement BFS transitions from \((x,y)\) to \((u,v)\) for matching labels, adding 2 to the distance.
Ensure initialization and visitation correctly handle overlaps, self-loops, and unreachable states.
Print the resulting distance matrix in the required format and validate against samples and edge cases.
